name: teacher-membership-pilot-base4-1gpu-20261022
description: Plumbing pilot on base Qwen3.5-4B: generation via .venv-startlux (vLLM 0.19.1), readout via .venv-sii; 100 rows, 2 chains.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
M=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B
D=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi
RUN=$R/runs/qz/teachers_pilot_base_20261022
LOG=$R/logs/qz/teacher_membership_pilot_base.log
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$RUN"
cd "$R"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
{
for VIEW in direct verify; do
  echo "===== VIEW $VIEW $(date -Is)"
  MODEL="$M" CHECKPOINT_ID="base-qwen3.5-4b-20261022" TEACHER_ID="base:$VIEW" TEACHER_VIEW="$VIEW" \
  SAMPLES=2 SHARDS=1 SPLITS="train dev" LIMIT=100 DATA_DIR="$D" RUN_ROOT="$RUN" \
  MAX_TOKENS=4096 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 \
  Q_TRANSFORM=membership TRUNCATED_POLICY=exclude \
  PYTHON_GENERATE="/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-startlux/bin/python" PYTHON_READOUT="$V/bin/python" \
  bash "$R/harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh" || { echo "VIEW $VIEW FAILED rc=$?"; exit 3; }
done
} > "$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
